checks._note: Rule 72/ج1: every segment centers its label horizontally AND vertically (of:parent — each label against its own segment box); icon-prefixed segments center the GROUP, which the label+icon flex row already does.
ActionBar min height = primary button 52 (size.button) + 2x12 block padding. The 24 padding is space.12 (no layout token; documented S7 value with the brief's 9.2 'safe area' text on top).
